summary:
Space Legacy: Forgotten Missions is a game we created as Team Threefold. In the game, you travel through the solar system, visit planets and moons, and discover NASA missions using real pictures and information.

We chose this idea because we wanted people to learn about space in a different way, instead of just reading about it. We also wanted to give attention to missions that are not talked about as much anymore.

We hope our game helps people learn new things while having fun exploring space.
details:
Our team, Threefold, created a game called Space Legacy: Forgotten Missions. We wanted to make something fun where people could learn about space while playing.

In our game, you can control a spaceship, visit planets and moons, and learn about NASA missions that some people might not know about. We also added real pictures, music, and a counter to see how many things you have discovered.

We used JavaScript, Phaser 3, Vite, GitHub, and information from NASA to make the game. We tried to keep it simple and easy to use, so kids and teenagers could enjoy it too.

We hope people have fun playing and learn something new about space along the way.
